bias.zh: 反弹 · 突破 $904–947，触及 10 日均线

read.en: SanDisk jumped 13.7% on Nov 11 to $977.69, trading $920.18–1,011.05 on heavy volume (1.41x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($873.1) and below the 10-day ($1,008.6), 30-day ($1,316.3), 100-day ($1,522.4) and 200-day ($1,278.7); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,198.41), and RSI is 37.4.

The rally cleared the $904–914.8 highs and the $926–947 Apr 23–24 lows, now support; the $1,011.05 high stalled at the 10-day and the $1,014 Nov 4 low. Resistance is $1,008.6–1,014, then $1,037.4 (Nov 4 close) and $1,067–1,075 (Nov 2 low and close). Support is $920–947, then $904–914.8 and $873–887 (5-day, Nov 9 close). A close above $1,014 would target $1,037–1,075; below $920, $904–915.

s.en: Nov 9 high $904; Nov 6 high $912.09; Nov 10 high $914.82
